reviews.title: amazing
reviews.body: wow i didn’t really think this stuff would work. slight skeptic with collagen being effective but it absolutely works, i notice a huge difference in a week actually. my skin is glowing and a lot of fine lines have erased and my skin is tighter all over honestly will buy again and again! it doesn’t taste like the high grade match i usually buy it taste much lighter but the benefits outweigh the taste. i mix mine with milk and hot water for a light latte in the morning and afternoon if i need a pick me up

reviews.author: Greenwoman

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.body: I noticed the positive effect this collagen had on my skin within a short time frame—skin seemed to have firmer dewy appearance, & this is the only new thing I’ve added to my routine. Also started taking this because of recovering from knee injuries, now one of my knees isn’t making a crackling noise—I’m sure this product was a factor in that too. Really liked the matcha as I’m cutting down on coffee a bit & noticed I had energy but no jitters. It is a grassy taste but anyone who likes matcha tea won’t have a problem.  I noticed this dissolved in hot or cold which is great. Would be perfect addition to smoothies which I will try soon. It doesn’t come with a scoop but regular tablespoon was easy enough to use but will need a funnel if going to add to a water bottle (Dasani etc) or it will make a sticky mess on your counter. This is now a regular part of my health regime
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on November 22, 2023
reviews.author: jmc

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.body: I already like matcha, so when I started adding collagen into my daily routine and I found this I had to try.Before this I tried a different brand but that one had some kind of mushroom in it that was a taste I couldn't get past. This collagen matcha however was very good, I am finishing my second container of it. I don't drink it every day so one container lasts me 2-3 months.I used to do the traditional matcha so I had a matcha bamboo whisk from that which does a good job of getting rid of any clumps. I always make this matcha powder with 175°F water but you probably don't have to. I believe the container says it can be served cold as well but I haven't tried that.It works really well for matcha lattes though, and for me a nice oat milk creamer mixes well with this product and has a great flavor if you like the Starbucks matcha latte. I never add sugar/honey but you could.Very happy with it all in all!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 29, 2023
reviews.author: Kang-iji

reviews.title: Fave Matcha Brand
reviews.body: I’m no matcha purist but I do drink matcha almost every morning and this is by far my favorite brand. It blends perfectly (even with a milk frother) unlike many other matchas I’ve tried that end up clumpy.  It’s great whether drinking it hot or iced.

reviews.title: Container is not full!!
reviews.body: I was excited to open and try this because I’ve recently gotten into matcha. I open it up and take the tab off to be disappointed. The container is not even close to being full it looked as if someone had spilled about a 1/4 of the powder out. The taste was ok but did not taste like regular matcha.

reviews.body: I love starting my day with a Macha collagen protein latte. I add steamed almond milk and water to two scoops of the Matcha collagen and it taste great lower calorie and still get all the protein I need in the morning.

reviews.title: tastes good & benefits are real
reviews.body: I give this matcha collagen an 8/10. It’s not the strong earthy matcha taste I prefer and it doesn’t work trying to add more powder but overall it still tastes good. Taste varies depending on milk! I’ve tried it with diff oat milk brands and it’s vary in taste. I wish it came with more servings but it’s not bad. Amazon offer the best price for this product as well as it’s not available everywhere. Lastly the very reason I stopped purchasing this is was because I couldn’t drink it on the go because as soon as I finished it I would need to crap!! like right away too! It was so annoying

features: Collagen: Meet Your Matcha ---- Our Matcha Collagen Peptides is sourced from high-quality Japanese matcha green tea and grass-fed, pasture-raised bovine hide.

Key Nutritionals Per Serving ---- 10g collagen peptides to support healthy hair, skin, nails, bones and joints and promote a youthful appearance,**^ 2-4g sugar, 50mg caffeine, 20mg L-theanine. Rich in antioxidants, matcha contains 137 times the amount of antioxidants as other green teas.
Your Daily Pick-Me-Up**---- Each serving provides an energy boost thanks to Matcha's caffeine content.**
Dietary Compliant ---- Free of gluten, dairy & added sugars. Digested and absorbed by the body quickly for maximum benefits.
How To Use ---- Our Matcha Collagen Peptides is easily digested and soluble in hot or cold liquids. Add 2 tablespoons to water, coconut milk or smoothies for a flavorful boost to your day.
